outcome: Child sleep variables (number of night wakings, duration of night wakings, duration of settling time, maternal rating of child's sleep problems)
cohort: The study included 1480 mothers and their children from the population-based Akershus Birth Cohort in Norway.
finding: Maternal postpartum PTSD symptoms were significantly associated with less favorable child sleep, specifically predicting an increased number and duration of night wakings, longer settling time, and higher maternal ratings of child sleep problems two years postpartum.
